TASK21 is done. All 170 tests pass, the analyzer has nothing new, and `flutter build linux --debug` builds. The one analyzer note left is the `containsSemantics` deprecation in `test/room_view_test.dart:430`, which was there before this task. Nothing is committed yet.

## The model as built (`app/lib/media.dart`)
- **`MediaKind`** `{video, audio, live}` and **`MediaSourceKind`** `{local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm}`. `sourceKindOf(ref)` works out the source from a ref's prefix, so refs on the wire are unchanged (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`).
- **`MediaItem`** (`media.dart:21`): the ref, title, subtitle, kind, source, duration, poster URL and aspect ratio. `mediaMatches(item, query)` does the search.
- **`MediaSource`** (`media.dart:72`) is the abstract base. It has `kind`, `label`, `ready`, `available`, `account`, `emptyHint` and `actions` (`MediaSourceAction`), plus three methods:
  - `browse({query})` lists the items.
  - `ensureReady()` handles sign-in.
  - `open(item)` returns a `Future<LocalCopy?>`.
- **The four adapters:**
  - `LocalMediaSource` lists files opened this session, with a `Choose file…` action.
  - `JellyfinMediaSource` restores the saved session and shows posters. If the server says the token is invalid (HTTP 401), it drops the session. Its `ensureReady` is the old Jellyfin dialog, now just the sign-in form (`showJellyfinSignIn`).
  - `SoonMediaSource` covers YouTube and Music, both marked unavailable.

## How sources register
`mediaSources(local:, jellyfin:)` (`media.dart:104`) returns one entry per adapter, in tab order. The library builds its tabs from that list, so adding a source means writing a `MediaSource` subclass and adding one line there. Home builds the list once and passes it to `RoomScreen`.

- **Home:** a `Pick media` button replaces the old inline links, and drag-and-drop still works. The `Library` chip sits in the brand column.
